description: IRA owner born in 1954, age 72 in 2026: start age 73, so no distribution is required yet.
worked:
IRA owner born 1954-03-10; age attained on the 2026 birthday = 2026 - 1954 = 72. Beneficiary is not a spouse more than 10 years younger, so the Uniform Lifetime Table applies.
Required beginning age (IRC 401(a)(9)(C)(v) as amended by SECURE 2.0): born 1954 -> age 73; first distribution year = 1954 + 73 = 2027.
2026 is before 2027 (age 72 is under 73): no required minimum distribution for 2026; required amount 0.
